content: ⌊ DRAFT g Semantics of meta-class DiagnosticEventToSe- curityEventMapping The occurrence of some security events need to be persisted in the context of the Dem. Technically, this mechanism boils down to a reporting of a diagnostic event in response to the occurrence of a security event. This approach is made possible by the existence of the DiagnosticEventToSecu- rityEventMapping .
